newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt higher in a very limited test, USDA said.

Inquiry good, demand moderate. Sales confirmed on 1,900 slaughter steers and 1,500 slaughter heifers Tuesday. Week-to-date 18,900 head confirmed including 15,300 head or about 81 percent of previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 64.00; Dressed basis - Select and Choice 12001250 lbs 103.50-105.00 hot weights, delivered.
